pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction (North American Neutral Accent)
pro_course_detail.description:
As of 3/29/2024 I will only be offering 45 and 30 minute classes of this specific lesson. If you have already booked 1 hour lessons, we will continue to do those until the end of your package. 
In these lessons, I break down each of the sounds that ESL students struggle with the most. We use diagrams, mouth positioning exercises and listening exercises to really get into the physical reason behind why accents happen. I emphasize and practice intonation and cadence in class. I focus on helping the student perfect the pronunciation of some of the most difficult sounds in the English language such as "schwa", long & short vowel sounds, consonant endings and the dreaded "r" sound amongst others.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking refinement.  Accent, pronunciation, and vocal expression.
pro_course_detail.description: This class is focused on language expression refinement.  Often times people learning a new language will earn a certain proficiency, but stop there, without refining their grammar, intonation and vocal expression to a professional level.  Speaking refinement is the essential next step for sounding professional in any higher-level career opportunity.  As a person who is in management, in higher-end sales, or in a refined field, such as medical, teaching, or business, a certain level of professionalism is mandatory.  Learn the nuances in language, and be able to not just speak to be understood, but speak in such a way that you present confidence and professionalism through fine-tuning not just what you you say, but how you say it.  This will involve exercises on pronunciation, syllable emphasis, stress and intonation (and help you sound more credible as a native speaker!).   This class will help you transition from being able to express ideas as an entry-level employee, to being able to express thoughts like a respected, well-versed manager/owner.  Please let me know what career field you are in, so I can personalize the lesson for you, and offer targeted vocabulary which compliments your specialty.

pro_course_detail.title: Kids (Ages 3-18, All levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
Kids have a mind that is wired to explore, learn and grow.  It is never too early to start learning a new language.  This class would involve interactive lessons designed to engage young minds in the joys of learning.  Whether a student is quiet and reserved, or playful and energetic, every learner has a path to success.  Students and parents can choose which lesson they would like to cover that day.  Some sample topics for beginner-intermediate includes, greetings, talking about family, talking about food, talking about school, talking about farm animals, talking about wildlife, talking about the seasons, and talking about clothing.  Beginners will engage in various activities to learn the names of various nouns and actions.  Intermediate learners will begin to learn how to use nouns and verbs in sentences.  More advanced learners will begin how to express thoughts in spontaneous conversation.  Some students prefer learning through songs and games and others prefer to learn through focused conversation.  The most popular class is a reading and comprehension class.  Please let me know of your student's level, learning preferences and topic interests, so I can personalize it for him/her!

It is strongly recommended that kids ages 3-9 are booked for 30-minute classes only as their attention spans are shorter and they do better in shorter segments.

Please be sure to select the kids class if the class is for children under the age of 14.  Older children may be able to switch into intermediate material.  Levels for the student can be determined after the first lesson.  I look forward to working with you.

In this course, I teach the student how to give a proper introduction and conclusion to a presentation; how to move from one topic to another; how to emphasize important points; how to describe numerical data using charts; how to keep and focus audience attention with rhetorical devices; how to answer questions during or after the presentation; and how to use correct English intonation when speaking.  If possible, I would like to work together on a real presentation that the student plans to give in the future.  I can prepare you for presentations in any industry, not just Sales (italki forces teachers to choose one industry, but I have experience in several).  You should only choose this if you are planning to take all 5 lessons with me for a total cost of $275.  Please note that I will wait a maximum of 20 minutes for a student to arrive in the chatroom and begin the class; after that, I will disconnect from Skype and will apply to italki for full payment for the session, with no obligation to re-schedule. I also will not re-schedule or refund ITC credits for classes canceled within 24 hours, so please don't ask me to do this.  We can use online platforms such as MS Teams, FaceTime, Skype, Zoom, GoToMeeting or WebEx, if you have accounts with these services; I do not accept appointments using italki Classroom.

teacher_info.introduction: I originally come from Boston, USA, but now you will find me settled in beautiful Greece ! Growing up as a bilingual, I had the chance to meet the culture and tradition of both countries and as a result fall in love with their languages. So it was almost inevitable for me not to follow what I loved for my profession. After graduating from university, I started working in different language schools and started building up my own student base by offering private lessons to both children and adults. In the classes, I noticed that some children were finding it difficult to keep up with the rest so after some time they actually started disliking the language itself, which was upsetting me. That was when I decided to deepen my knowledge in special education , in order to help those kids or individuals, since many adults face the same problem too; to overcome this problem and have fun while learning English. Throughout the years, I have mostly taught greek students who wanted to get prepared for a B2 or C2 examination, but lately a big number of those wanted to get prepared in order to sit the IELTS (band 6.5+) or TOEFL (score 100+) or simply advance their spoken English,so they could study or move to another country. Apart from teaching I have also taken part in different projects in the filed of teaching, such as proofreader for Cambrdige and Michigan test books, voice actor for ECPE, ECCE test books.

teacher_info.teaching_style: In Greece most of my students are interested in obtaining some sort of certificate (level B1 - C2), which makes the lesson more test oriented. pro_course_detail.description: In these lessons we will have conversations on various topics and themes that will allow you to practice your speaking and conversation ability. Let's get talking!

pro_course_detail.title: English Grammar & Vocabulary Lesson
pro_course_detail.description: In these lessons we will focus on areas of grammar that English learners most often struggle with. I will assess areas in which you need to improve and work with you to find your goals and objectives in understanding grammar. We will build a large bank of new vocabulary for your to learn and practice to become a more confident, fluent speaker. We will use lots of grammar & Vocabulary books and materials while also using texts, music and videos to analyze and practice English grammar!

pro_course_detail.description:
These sessions will give you direct and helpful feedback on your writing skills. 
We can work on improving your work emails, PowerPoint presentations for your projects, essays, and more! 
Book an hour-long lesson for work in class to discuss and practice your writing and receive details feedback and opportunities to practice in the lesson time.
Book a short, 30-minute session to receive feedback and corrections on texts and written work outside of the lesson. You would send me a text and I would review it and make any necessary corrections and we would briefly discuss them in a 30 minute lesson. 
Whatever you need to improve your writing for, I can help!
